hack.root_cause: Unvalidated external call in upgraded DEX Aggregation contract — approval drain
hack.description: Unizen lost $2.1M when a gas optimization upgrade to their DEX aggregation contract introduced an unvalidated external call vulnerability, enabling multiple attackers to drain token approvals from users' wallets within hours.
